components.name: Fieldset
components.description: One label, one control (or a group of controls), one message. Swap the “Control” slot for a Chip row, Checkbox or Radio group, Segmented control, Slider, Date picker or Uploader. Do not wrap Text field or Select — their label is built in. Message: Helper (text/tertiary), Error (text/danger + alert icon), Success (text/success + check). React: <Fieldset label message status>.
